name: H350
summary: SAF powder bed fusion for cost-efficient, higher-volume production of nylon parts.

page.description: Stratasys H350 3D printer from IME Additive Manufacturing, Malaysia: specifications, applications and pricing.
page.headline: Cost-efficient,
page.lead: Selective Absorption Fusion with industrial piezo printheads and closed-loop thermal control produces repeatable nylon parts: hundreds per build in under 12 hours†.
page.footnote: † Stratasys claims; typical nesting is about 12 %. Source: stratasys.com H350 page, read 10 Nov 2026.

features.title: Compact and scalable
features.text: Two H350 systems in the space of one competing solution (Stratasys claim).

features.title: Advanced thermal control
features.text: Closed-loop heating with distributed ceramic heaters and thermal cameras.

features.title: Industrial piezo printheads
features.text: No consumable printheads or cleaning rolls; printheads under warranty.

features.title: Fixed print times
features.text: Consistent part quality and predictable scheduling.

features.title: PowderEase T1
features.text: Automates breakout, sieving, dosing and loading.

benefits.title: Lower cost per part
benefits.text: Efficient powder use and minimal consumables.

benefits.title: Scalable production
benefits.text: Serial production of repeatable end-use parts.

benefits.title: Simpler workflow
benefits.text: One operator can run several printers.

specs.label: Process
specs.value: Selective Absorption Fusion with High Absorption Fluid

specs.label: Materials
specs.value: SAF PA12, SAF PA12 Powered by Evonik, High Yield PA11, SAF PP, SAF ReLife PA12

specs.label: Powder capacity
specs.value: 40 kg, enough for two full builds (Stratasys claim)

page.applications_heading: End-use nylon parts at production volume.

applications.title: End-of-arm tooling
applications.text: Lighter, organic designs for robot tools.
